comparison.objective: Hot-swap a failed server power supply without moving the live supply.
comparison.physical_skill: Operate a release latch, extract one heavy module, align and insert a replacement in a crowded bay.
comparison.success_condition: Spare seated and latched in failed bay, failed unit clear, live unit never moved over 5 mm, replacement stable 1 s.
comparison.reason: Module extraction and blind rail insertion are unrelated to granular separation. Spec versions clarify latch nomenclature and dwell timing without changing the tested ability.
